name: Death and Tribute trails the character like the rest of its Three Totems chain (#9218)
contract: Quest 1660030 (Death and Tribute, first quest of the Three Totems/Red Cloud Mesa narrative chain in Mulgore) is a level-6 quest. Its client QuestTemplateScaling.dbc row caps it at 20, same as the other six quests of its chain (1660031-1660035, 1660043), even though the chain is a substantive narrative arc (disguise, infiltration, a named boss), not a starting-hub errand, so AscensionQuestScaling corrects the row's maximum to 60 after loading, same as quest 45's Elwynn precedent. A level-49 character with open-world scaling on therefore plays the quest at 45 (49 - 4) instead of the row maximum of 20, and a level-60 character at 56 (60 - 4). QuestXP.dbc RewardXPDifficulty 5 gives 5540 at level 45 and 8450 at level 56, both well above the old capped value (155 at level 20); the exact award depends on the deployed Rate.XP.Quest, so the scenario asserts the quest level, a lower bound the old capped value cannot reach, and that the quest log preview and the award agree. A second level-49 character keeps scaling off: the quest stays at its authored level 6 and keeps the small stock level-difference reward. No prestige aura, experience aura or test zone is active. Client rendering is not tested.

steps.label: At 49 the quest trails the character to 45
The quest log offers the level-45 reward
The award does not cross a level
The award matches the offered reward
At 60 the quest trails the character to 56
The quest log offers the level-56 reward
The award matches the offered reward
Without scaling the quest keeps its authored level
Without scaling the stock level difference still pays
An unscaled quest keeps the stock reward
